question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) boundaries and methodology in relation to sustainability?
data_point: life cycle assessment (lca) boundaries and methodology
description: Life cycle assessment (LCA) boundaries and methodology are tools used to evaluate the environmental impacts of a product or service throughout its entire life cycle. Boundaries define the scope of the LCA, determining which stages and processes are included in the assessment. Methodology outlines the steps and procedures for conducting the LCA, including goal and scope definition, inventory analysis, impact assessment, and interpretation. Together, they help identify and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems, enabling informed decision-making for sustainable development.
